cd55179310.why: Within each 128-bit lane, the constant byte shuffle turns each qword unpack into a word interleave, so VPUNPCKLWD and VPUNPCKHWD each replace an unpack plus VPSHUFB. The permutations, live mask load, stores, flags, and VZEROUPPER effects are preserved.

586177a30a.why: Both the transposed low halves of ymm0 through ymm3 and the shuffled low halves of ymm8 through ymm11 are required, as are all eight overlapping stores and the upper-half clearing.

59045ea365.why: The loaded constant in ymm8 is a required final value, so folding it into the comparison would not eliminate the load.

a40d825085.why: For arbitrary input dwords, the two shifts and two OR operations are necessary, and AVX2 provides no fused three-input OR to shorten them.

e7ffb8e638.why: The two shifts and two OR operations combine arbitrary input bits, so arithmetic substitutions cannot safely reduce the sequence under AVX2.

7e690fe4b8.why: The shifted inputs may overlap for arbitrary dword values, requiring both OR operations in addition to the two shifts and scalar operations.

5a322d9559.why: The two bounded word fields each need a pair of shifts without an available mask, while the upper field and required scalar state already use one instruction each.

fd04fc2f04.why: The five-bit and six-bit bounded fields require their shift pairs without a supplied mask, while the upper-field shift and scalar operations are already direct.

cc01b26d79.why: Each of the two required vector results already uses a single byte-to-word widening instruction, alongside the required scalar load and pointer update.

1bd63294b3.why: Each of the three independent vector results already uses one widening instruction, and neither scalar operation is redundant.
